claims.claim: WithMCP registers all tools from the server
NewMCPServer builder methods WithEnv, WithArgs, WithWorkingDir, WithTimeout(ms), WithToolFilter
Allowlist exposes only named tools; Blocklist exposes all but named; allowlist takes precedence when both are set
Entries ending in * match a prefix
Tool names are registered as mcp__{serverName}__{toolName}
Reference the names in allowed_tools if you want to restrict which MCP tools are available
Multiple servers register with one WithMCPServer option each
Third-party server tool names (search_repositories, get_file_contents, read_file, echo)
WithMCP/builder commands run as an unsandboxed subprocess
A server whose tools cannot be listed is retried in the background and logs a warning
conv.ToolRegistry().List() returns the registered tool names
